items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Yank used to play with us too

ctx.x: Yeah. So, uh, Earl, uh, Humphrey was trombone, was he? No. In the band? Yeah, Earl. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

On the band? On the band? Yeah, yeah, yeah. On the band? On the band, yeah. Well, and, uh, Clash Gabriel was on the guitar, wasn't it? I think. And Willie LaBeff was on drums. And, uh, this boy Yank, I think, was on trombone. No, Earl was on trombone, yeah. Uh, trombone, yeah. Uh, Yank used to play with us too, you know, from Al Jase. Which band? Whose band? He used to play with the Lewiston man. The Louis Dumaine, what do you think? Louis Dumaine. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And, uh... How did Yank play? Oh, yeah.
I don't think he made any records. What kind of a style did he have? Was he something like Deucin or like Ory or who?
